legal.draftNotice: This document describes how the site actually works. It is not legal advice — have a lawyer review it before launch.

p: Mithoo Media Group ("we") is responsible for the information you send us through this site. For any question, write to {email}.

When you complete the inquiry form: your name, business name, email, phone, preferred channel and language, information about your business, services of interest, budget (if provided) and your message.
Technical information: IP address for spam and abuse protection (rate limiting), and the page you were on when you submitted the form.
We do not ask for sensitive information such as card numbers or identity documents in the form.
To respond to your request, prepare a proposal and follow up on the project.
We send you a confirmation email and a limited number of follow-up messages directly related to your request. You can ask us to stop at any time.
We send newsletters or marketing content ONLY if you ticked the optional box. You can unsubscribe from any email.
Your information is stored in our CRM (GoHighLevel / LeadConnector) and on the website server. We may use a transactional email provider to send messages. We do not sell your information.

We keep lead records for as long as the business relationship lasts, and for a reasonable period afterwards for legal and accounting obligations. Backup copies on the website server are deleted automatically after they are synced to the CRM.
You can ask us to delete your information at any time.
The site remembers your chosen language in your browser (localStorage). If we enable analytics, it only loads after you accept it in the banner.
You can ask to access, correct or delete your information, or withdraw your consent, by writing to {email}.
The content of this site is general information about Mithoo Media Group's services. Submitting a request does not create any contract or obligation.
Deliverables, pricing, timelines and support are defined in a written proposal or contract for each project.

For Shopify, Amazon, Walmart Marketplace, TikTok Shop, Meta, Google and other platforms, we provide setup, optimization and consulting services. Account approval, eligibility, rules and fees are controlled by those platforms.
Marketing and sales results depend on many factors outside our control. We do not guarantee any level of revenue, traffic or sales.
The brand, text and design of this site belong to Mithoo Media Group. Client names and logos belong to their respective owners.
